(A) Section 499 & 500
(B) Section 124A
(C) Section 66A (struck down)
(D) Section 8(1)

List II:
(I) Indian Penal Code (Defamation definition and punishment)
(II) Indian Penal Code (Sedition definition and punishment)
(III) Information Technology Act (Online offensive messages)
(IV) Right to Information Act (Exemptions from disclosure)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
